  "root_cause_analysis": "The model failed to decompose the multi-part request into all necessary parallel function calls. It appears to have partially addressed the comparison aspect but omitted the second temporal dimension (2023 estimates) and used an incorrect year (2020) for both calls.",

  "key_insight": "In parallel scenarios with multi-dimensional requests (multiple species × multiple years), ensure all combinations are enumerated as separate function calls. The model truncated the request scope rather than fully materializing the Cartesian product of parameters."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
